04/10.06.2024
 Heard the Parties.

Petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Barharwa P.S. Case No. 161 of 2023,
registered under Sections 498A/ 323/ 379/313/406/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act, pending in the Court of Sri P. Ranjan, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Rajmahal.
Petitioner No.1 is the mother-in-law, petitioner Nos.2 and 3 are the married sister-in-law and petitioner No.4 is the father-in-law of the informant.

It is alleged that the informant was married to Najim Sheikh in the year 2022, after marriage she was tortured to enforce the demand of dowry and ultimately she was driven away from his matrimonial home.
Mr. Raja Ravi Shekhar, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that informant had not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioners.
It was further submitted that petitioner Nos.1, 2 and 3 are ladies and petitioner No.4 is the father-in-law aged about 54 years and there is no specific allegation against these petitioners.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for Anticipatory Bail.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioners.
